findings.finding: G-22 sets the answer 100 s after the completed set's start on both clocks, so the wall age alone refuses it. It therefore does not catch the monotonic-only form of D3-1's hazard: a port that takes the monotonic start from the newer (advanced) entry while the wall start stays set_started_ms. Mutants P1 (monotonic start from the newest set entry) and P3 (the largest scheduled start of any entry) survive with G-16 removed and die only at G-16, through the negative-age rule, because G-16's incomplete set lies after its answer.
